calibration_verdict: Novel / research (<5k LOC but uses ML/Graph techniques). Deep audit.

inventory.name: Local Dense Embedding Search (UniXcoder/CodeT5)
inventory.description: Uses lightweight local models (UniXcoder) to generate dense embeddings for semantic search.
inventory.steel_man: Adding PyTorch/transformers to Cortex's distribution would massively bloat the install size and memory footprint.

inventory.name: Proximity Search with BFS Radius Expansion
inventory.description: After finding KNN centers, it performs a bounded BFS (radius and max_size constraints) across the topological graph to pull in adjacent context.
inventory.steel_man: Cortex's existing Context Packs and Proximity Reranking might already naturally pull in this information without an explicit graph BFS.

inventory.name: Path-Pattern DFS Expansion
inventory.description: Expands the graph context only if the DFS path follows a specific sequence of edge types (e.g., import -> call), driven by a patterns.json file.
inventory.steel_man: Maintaining strict edge-type schemas across dynamic workspaces is fragile compared to Cortex's generalized [[WikiLink]] graph.

inventory.name: Explicit Tree-Sitter Traversal Queries
inventory.description: Uses Tree-Sitter queries with negative `#not-a-child-of` constraints to cleanly extract module-level functions separately from methods.
inventory.steel_man: Cortex's AST skeleton extractor is already heavily optimized in Phase 13.7; switching to this query style might break existing robust delta compression.

inventory.name: Graph Neural Network Context Link Predictor
inventory.description: Uses a deep GNN to rank and predict the most useful topological context nodes for code completion.
inventory.steel_man: Violates Cortex Principle #1 and #3: Local-first and LLM-cost-conscious. We prefer fast heuristics over training a GNN per repository.
